configure_profiling_capture_range: configure profiling to capture a specific range of training steps using capture_start_step and num_steps_to_capture
mark_step_start_on_start_step: mark the start of a training step for profiling internal bookkeeping using on_start_step
annotate_range_with_range_push_pop: annotate the start and end of a profiling range using range_push and range_pop for Nsight capture
use_range_context_decorator: use RangeContext as a decorator to mark an entire function as a profiling range for Nsight
use_range_context_with_statement: use RangeContext in a with statement to annotate a code block as a profiling range
